San data access rule: never destructure this.data or treat it as a plain object. Read fields separately, for example const initialGroups = this.data.get('initialGroups'), then write state with this.data.set(...).
Object-style Vue :class bindings must be converted to a San string expression. Never emit class="{{{ selected: condition }}}"; use a ternary string expression such as class="{{ condition ? 'selected' : '' }}" and concatenate multiple conditional class names.
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。

        <span>审核 {{progress}}%</span>
        <span>缺失 {{missingCount}} 项</span>
        <span s-if="submittedAt">{{submittedAt}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="{{'locale-layout ' + (showGlossary ? 'with-glossary' : '')}}">
        <aside class="entry-list">
            <input placeholder="搜索" value="{{query}}" on-input="updateQuery" />
            <select value="{{filter}}" on-change="updateFilter">
                <option value="all">全部</option>
                <option value="missing">缺失</option>
                <option value="unreviewed">待审核</option>
            </select>
            <button s-for="record in visibleRecords trackby record.key" class="{{(record.key === selectedKey ? 'selected' : '') + ' ' + (record.reviewed[language] ? 'reviewed' : '')}}" on-click="selectRecord(record.key)">
                <strong>{{record.key}}</strong>
                <span>{{record.source}}</span>
                <small>{{translationFor(record)}}</small>
            </button>
            <p class="empty" s-if="!visibleRecords.length">无匹配文案</p>
        </aside>
        <main s-if="selectedRecord">
            <div class="source-panel">
                <span>源文案</span>
                <strong>{{selectedRecord.source}}</strong>
                <small>{{selectedRecord.key}}</small>
            </div>
            <label>
                目标译文
                <textarea value="{{draft}}" on-input="updateDraft"></textarea>
            </label>
            <div class="editor-actions">
                <span>{{draft.length}} 字符</span>
                <button class="primary" disabled="{{!draft}}" on-click="markReviewed">保存并审核</button>
            </div>
        </main>
        <aside class="glossary" s-if="showGlossary">
            <h3>推荐术语</h3>
            <button s-for="term in glossary trackby term.source" on-click="applyTerm(term)">
                <span>{{term.source}}</span>
                <strong>{{term.target}}</strong>
            </button>
        </aside>
    </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'LocalizationWorkspace',
    components: {},
    dataTypes: {
        projectName: DataTypes.string,
        languages: DataTypes.array,
        entries: DataTypes.array,
        glossary: DataTypes.array
    },
    initData() {
        return {
            records: [],
            language: 'en',
            query: '',
            filter: 'all',
            selectedKey: '',
            draft: '',
            showGlossary: true,
            dirtyKeys: [],
            submittedAt: ''
        };
    },
    inited() {
        const entries = this.data.get('entries') || [];
        const languages = this.data.get('languages') || [];
        const records = entries.map(item => ({
            key: item.key,
            source: item.source,
            translations: Object.assign({}, item.translations),
            reviewed: Object.assign({}, item.reviewed)
        }));
        this.data.set('records', records);
        this.data.set('language', languages[0] ? languages[0].code : '');
        this.data.set('selectedKey', entries[0] ? entries[0].key : '');
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    computed: {
        visibleRecords() {
            const q = this.data.get('query').toLowerCase();
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const filter = this.data.get('filter');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            return records.filter(item => (
                (item.key.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || item.source.indexOf(this.data.get('query')) >= 0) &&
                (filter === 'all' || (filter === 'missing' ? !item.translations[language] : !item.reviewed[language]))
            ));
        },
        selectedRecord() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const selectedKey = this.data.get('selectedKey');
            return records.find(item => item.key === selectedKey) || null;
        },
        progress() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            if (!records.length) return 0;
            const reviewedCount = records.filter(item => item.reviewed[language]).length;
            return Math.round(reviewedCount / records.length * 100);
        },
        missingCount() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            return records.filter(item => !item.translations[language]).length;
        },
        currentLanguageName() {
            const languages = this.data.get('languages') || [];
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            const item = languages.find(row => row.code === language);
            return item ? item.name : '';
        }
    },
    setValue(key, value) {
        this.data.set(key, value);
    },
    emitEvent(name, payload) {
        this.fire(name, payload);
    },
    updateLanguage(event) {
        this.commitDraft();
        this.data.set('language', event.target.value);
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    updateQuery(event) {
        this.data.set('query', event.target.value);
    },
    updateFilter(event) {
        this.data.set('filter', event.target.value);
    },
    selectRecord(key) {
        this.commitDraft();
        this.data.set('selectedKey', key);
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    updateDraft(event) {
        this.data.set('draft', event.target.value);
    },
    loadDraft() {
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const selectedKey = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const record = records.find(item => item.key === selectedKey);
        this.data.set('draft', record ? (record.translations[language] || '') : '');
    },
    commitDraft() {
        const key = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        if (!key) return;
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const value = this.data.get('draft');
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const newRecords = records.map(item =>
            item.key === key
                ? {
                    ...item,
                    translations: { ...item.translations, [language]: value },
                    reviewed: { ...item.reviewed, [language]: false }
                }
                : item
        );
        this.data.set('records', newRecords);
        const dirtyKeys = this.data.get('dirtyKeys');
        if (dirtyKeys.indexOf(key) < 0) {
            this.data.set('dirtyKeys', [...dirtyKeys, key]);
        }
        this.fire('translation-change', { key, language, value });
    },
    markReviewed() {
        this.commitDraft();
        const key = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const newRecords = records.map(item =>
            item.key === key
                ? { ...item, reviewed: { ...item.reviewed, [language]: true } }
                : item
        );
        this.data.set('records', newRecords);
        this.fire('review', { key, language });
    },
    applyTerm(term) {
        const draft = this.data.get('draft');
        this.data.set('draft', draft + (draft ? ' ' : '') + term.target);
    },
    toggleGlossary() {
        this.data.set('showGlossary', !this.data.get('showGlossary'));
    },
    submitBatch() {
        this.commitDraft();
        const now = new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { hour12: false });
        this.data.set('submittedAt', now);
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const dirtyKeys = this.data.get('dirtyKeys');
        this.fire('submit', { language, keys: dirtyKeys });
        this.data.set('dirtyKeys', []);
    },
    translationFor(record) {
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        return record.translations[language] || '未翻译';
    }
});
</script>

detected_patterns.san_strategy: 存在 @click 或 v-on，需转为 on-click
存在 v-if，需转为 s-if
存在 v-for，需转为 s-for
存在 :attr 动态绑定，需保留属性绑定语法
存在 $emit 调用，需转为 this.fire
methods 中存在 this.xxx 访问，需统一改为 this.data.get/set

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

        <span>审核 {{progress}}%</span>
        <span>缺失 {{missingCount}} 项</span>
        <span s-if="submittedAt">{{submittedAt}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="{{'locale-layout ' + (showGlossary ? 'with-glossary' : '')}}">
        <aside class="entry-list">
            <input placeholder="搜索" value="{{query}}" on-input="updateQuery" />
            <select value="{{filter}}" on-change="updateFilter">
                <option value="all">全部</option>
                <option value="missing">缺失</option>
                <option value="unreviewed">待审核</option>
            </select>
            <button s-for="record in visibleRecords trackby record.key" class="{{(record.key === selectedKey ? 'selected' : '') + ' ' + (record.reviewed[language] ? 'reviewed' : '')}}" on-click="selectRecord(record.key)">
                <strong>{{record.key}}</strong>
                <span>{{record.source}}</span>
                <small>{{translationFor(record)}}</small>
            </button>
            <p class="empty" s-if="!visibleRecords.length">无匹配文案</p>
        </aside>
        <main s-if="selectedRecord">
            <div class="source-panel">
                <span>源文案</span>
                <strong>{{selectedRecord.source}}</strong>
                <small>{{selectedRecord.key}}</small>
            </div>
            <label>
                目标译文
                <textarea value="{{draft}}" on-input="updateDraft"></textarea>
            </label>
            <div class="editor-actions">
                <span>{{draft.length}} 字符</span>
                <button class="primary" disabled="{{!draft}}" on-click="markReviewed">保存并审核</button>
            </div>
        </main>
        <aside class="glossary" s-if="showGlossary">
            <h3>推荐术语</h3>
            <button s-for="term in glossary trackby term.source" on-click="applyTerm(term)">
                <span>{{term.source}}</span>
                <strong>{{term.target}}</strong>
            </button>
        </aside>
    </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'LocalizationWorkspace',
    components: {},
    dataTypes: {
        projectName: DataTypes.string,
        languages: DataTypes.array,
        entries: DataTypes.array,
        glossary: DataTypes.array
    },
    initData() {
        return {
            records: [],
            language: 'en',
            query: '',
            filter: 'all',
            selectedKey: '',
            draft: '',
            showGlossary: true,
            dirtyKeys: [],
            submittedAt: ''
        };
    },
    inited() {
        const entries = this.data.get('entries') || [];
        const languages = this.data.get('languages') || [];
        const records = entries.map(item => ({
            key: item.key,
            source: item.source,
            translations: Object.assign({}, item.translations),
            reviewed: Object.assign({}, item.reviewed)
        }));
        this.data.set('records', records);
        this.data.set('language', languages[0] ? languages[0].code : '');
        this.data.set('selectedKey', entries[0] ? entries[0].key : '');
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    computed: {
        visibleRecords() {
            const q = this.data.get('query').toLowerCase();
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const filter = this.data.get('filter');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            return records.filter(item => (
                (item.key.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || item.source.indexOf(this.data.get('query')) >= 0) &&
                (filter === 'all' || (filter === 'missing' ? !item.translations[language] : !item.reviewed[language]))
            ));
        },
        selectedRecord() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const selectedKey = this.data.get('selectedKey');
            return records.find(item => item.key === selectedKey) || null;
        },
        progress() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            if (!records.length) return 0;
            const reviewedCount = records.filter(item => item.reviewed[language]).length;
            return Math.round(reviewedCount / records.length * 100);
        },
        missingCount() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            return records.filter(item => !item.translations[language]).length;
        },
        currentLanguageName() {
            const languages = this.data.get('languages') || [];
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            const item = languages.find(row => row.code === language);
            return item ? item.name : '';
        }
    },
    setValue(key, value) {
        this.data.set(key, value);
    },
    emitEvent(name, payload) {
        this.fire(name, payload);
    },
    updateLanguage(event) {
        this.commitDraft();
        this.data.set('language', event.target.value);
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    updateQuery(event) {
        this.data.set('query', event.target.value);
    },
    updateFilter(event) {
        this.data.set('filter', event.target.value);
    },
    selectRecord(key) {
        this.commitDraft();
        this.data.set('selectedKey', key);
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    updateDraft(event) {
        this.data.set('draft', event.target.value);
    },
    loadDraft() {
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const selectedKey = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const record = records.find(item => item.key === selectedKey);
        this.data.set('draft', record ? (record.translations[language] || '') : '');
    },
    commitDraft() {
        const key = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        if (!key) return;
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const value = this.data.get('draft');
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const newRecords = records.map(item =>
            item.key === key
                ? {
                    ...item,
                    translations: { ...item.translations, [language]: value },
                    reviewed: { ...item.reviewed, [language]: false }
                }
                : item
        );
        this.data.set('records', newRecords);
        const dirtyKeys = this.data.get('dirtyKeys');
        if (dirtyKeys.indexOf(key) < 0) {
            this.data.set('dirtyKeys', [...dirtyKeys, key]);
        }
        this.fire('translation-change', { key, language, value });
    },
    markReviewed() {
        this.commitDraft();
        const key = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const newRecords = records.map(item =>
            item.key === key
                ? { ...item, reviewed: { ...item.reviewed, [language]: true } }
                : item
        );
        this.data.set('records', newRecords);
        this.fire('review', { key, language });
    },
    applyTerm(term) {
        const draft = this.data.get('draft');
        this.data.set('draft', draft + (draft ? ' ' : '') + term.target);
    },
    toggleGlossary() {
        this.data.set('showGlossary', !this.data.get('showGlossary'));
    },
    submitBatch() {
        this.commitDraft();
        const now = new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { hour12: false });
        this.data.set('submittedAt', now);
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const dirtyKeys = this.data.get('dirtyKeys');
        this.fire('submit', { language, keys: dirtyKeys });
        this.data.set('dirtyKeys', []);
    },
    translationFor(record) {
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        return record.translations[language] || '未翻译';
    }
});
</script>

detected_patterns.san_strategy: 存在 @click 或 v-on，需转为 on-click
存在 v-if，需转为 s-if
存在 v-for，需转为 s-for
存在 :attr 动态绑定，需保留属性绑定语法
存在 $emit 调用，需转为 this.fire
methods 中存在 this.xxx 访问，需统一改为 this.data.get/set

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

<section class="localization-workspace">
    <header>

    </div>
    <div class="{{'locale-layout ' + (showGlossary ? 'with-glossary' : '')}}">
        <aside class="entry-list">
            <input placeholder="搜索" value="{{query}}" on-input="updateQuery" />
            <select value="{{filter}}" on-change="updateFilter">

            </select>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'LocalizationWorkspace',
    components: {},
    dataTypes: {
        projectName: DataTypes.string,
        languages: DataTypes.array,
        entries: DataTypes.array,
        glossary: DataTypes.array
    },
    initData() {
        return {
            records: [],
            language: 'en',
            query: '',
            filter: 'all',
            selectedKey: '',
            draft: '',
            showGlossary: true,
            dirtyKeys: [],
            submittedAt: ''
        };
    },
    inited() {
        const entries = this.data.get('entries') || [];
        const languages = this.data.get('languages') || [];
        const records = entries.map(item => ({
            key: item.key,
            source: item.source,
            translations: Object.assign({}, item.translations),
            reviewed: Object.assign({}, item.reviewed)
        }));
        this.data.set('records', records);
        this.data.set('language', languages[0] ? languages[0].code : '');
        this.data.set('selectedKey', entries[0] ? entries[0].key : '');
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    computed: {
        visibleRecords() {
            const q = this.data.get('query').toLowerCase();
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const filter = this.data.get('filter');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            return records.filter(item => (
                (item.key.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || item.source.indexOf(this.data.get('query')) >= 0) &&
                (filter === 'all' || (filter === 'missing' ? !item.translations[language] : !item.reviewed[language]))
            ));
        },
        selectedRecord() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const selectedKey = this.data.get('selectedKey');
            return records.find(item => item.key === selectedKey) || null;
        },
        progress() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            if (!records.length) return 0;
            const reviewedCount = records.filter(item => item.reviewed[language]).length;
            return Math.round(reviewedCount / records.length * 100);
        },
        missingCount() {
            const records = this.data.get('records');
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            return records.filter(item => !item.translations[language]).length;
        },
        currentLanguageName() {
            const languages = this.data.get('languages') || [];
            const language = this.data.get('language');
            const item = languages.find(row => row.code === language);
            return item ? item.name : '';
        }
    },
    setValue(key, value) {
        this.data.set(key, value);
    },
    emitEvent(name, payload) {
        this.fire(name, payload);
    },
    updateLanguage(event) {
        this.commitDraft();
        this.data.set('language', event.target.value);
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    updateQuery(event) {
        this.data.set('query', event.target.value);
    },
    updateFilter(event) {
        this.data.set('filter', event.target.value);
    },
    selectRecord(key) {
        this.commitDraft();
        this.data.set('selectedKey', key);
        this.loadDraft();
    },
    updateDraft(event) {
        this.data.set('draft', event.target.value);
    },
    loadDraft() {
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const selectedKey = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const record = records.find(item => item.key === selectedKey);
        this.data.set('draft', record ? (record.translations[language] || '') : '');
    },
    commitDraft() {
        const key = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        if (!key) return;
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const value = this.data.get('draft');
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const newRecords = records.map(item =>
            item.key === key
                ? {
                    ...item,
                    translations: { ...item.translations, [language]: value },
                    reviewed: { ...item.reviewed, [language]: false }
                }
                : item
        );
        this.data.set('records', newRecords);
        const dirtyKeys = this.data.get('dirtyKeys');
        if (dirtyKeys.indexOf(key) < 0) {
            this.data.set('dirtyKeys', [...dirtyKeys, key]);
        }
        this.fire('translation-change', { key, language, value });
    },
    markReviewed() {
        this.commitDraft();
        const key = this.data.get('selectedKey');
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const records = this.data.get('records');
        const newRecords = records.map(item =>
            item.key === key
                ? { ...item, reviewed: { ...item.reviewed, [language]: true } }
                : item
        );
        this.data.set('records', newRecords);
        this.fire('review', { key, language });
    },
    applyTerm(term) {
        const draft = this.data.get('draft');
        this.data.set('draft', draft + (draft ? ' ' : '') + term.target);
    },
    toggleGlossary() {
        this.data.set('showGlossary', !this.data.get('showGlossary'));
    },
    submitBatch() {
        this.commitDraft();
        const now = new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { hour12: false });
        this.data.set('submittedAt', now);
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        const dirtyKeys = this.data.get('dirtyKeys');
        this.fire('submit', { language, keys: dirtyKeys });
        this.data.set('dirtyKeys', []);
    },
    translationFor(record) {
        const language = this.data.get('language');
        return record.translations[language] || '未翻译';
    }
});
</script>

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理
